build_pipeline: build a data processing pipeline using PipelineBuilder with source, pipe stages, and sink queue
start_pipeline: start the pipeline background thread with an optional timeout value for initialization
get_item: get the next item from the pipeline output queue with an optional timeout
auto_stop_context: use the auto_stop context manager to automatically start and stop the pipeline thread
iterate_pipeline: iterate over pipeline outputs using get_iterator with per-item timeout configuration
